notes: Trams, metro and buses: a 20-minute ticket is 3.40 PLN and a day ticket 15 PLN; use the Jakdojade app. The SKM airport train takes 20 minutes. Public transport is extensive, and trams are essential.
Summer is 22-27°C; look out for Sunday Chopin concerts at Łazienki (July-September 2026), Vistula beach bars and the Warsaw Summer Jazz Days.
Pierogi cost 30-40 PLN, a milk bar meal 20, the vodka museum 60, POLIN 45 and the Uprising Museum 30. Poland is good value, cards are accepted everywhere, and the tip is 10%.
Free days at museums: Royal Castle on Wednesday, POLIN on Thursday, Uprising Museum on Thursday, National Museum on Tuesday. POLIN and the Uprising Museum are CLOSED on Tuesday.
Milk bar (bar mleczny): take a tray, order at the counter, pay at the till; try Prasowy, Bambino and Rusałka.
Try Żubrówka with apple juice, żurek (sour rye soup), bigos (hunter's stew) and pączki (doughnuts; on Fat Thursday, in February).

stops.name: Castle Square Sigismund's Column
stops.tips: A UNESCO old town flattened in 1944 and rebuilt brick by brick; look for the king's column.

stops.name: Royal Castle Warsaw
stops.tips: The royal castle, with Rembrandts and Canaletto's views of Warsaw (used in the reconstruction). Free on Wednesdays.

stops.name: Old Town Market Square Syrenka
stops.tips: The mermaid statue, colourful merchants' houses, the Barbican and the city walls.

stops.name: Zapiecek Pierogarnia
stops.tips: A pierogi chain (in the old town): try ruskie (potato and cheese) and fried pierogi, with kompot.

stops.name: Krakowskie Przedmieście
stops.tips: The Royal Route: Presidential Palace, Chopin benches (they play music), the University and Hotel Bristol.

backups.name: Bar Mleczny Pod Barbakanem
backups.tips: A milk bar in the old town: kotlet (breaded cutlet) and naleśniki (filled crêpes).

backups.name: Warsaw Uprising Monument & Krasiński Garden
backups.tips: The Uprising monument and park; swap in for the column.

stops.name: POLIN Museum
stops.tips: 1,000 years of Polish Jewish history; one of Europe's best museums, with a wooden synagogue ceiling. Free on Thursdays, closed Tuesdays.

stops.name: Ghetto Heroes Monument
stops.tips: Rapoport's monument in front of the museum, where Willy Brandt knelt.

stops.name: Charlotte Menora Plac Grzybowski
stops.tips: A bakery-café next to the Nożyk Synagogue: bread and chałka (braided sweet bread).

stops.name: Nożyk Synagogue
stops.tips: The only synagogue to survive the war; see the ghetto-era houses on Próżna street.

stops.name: Hala Koszyki
stops.tips: A food hall in a 1908 market hall; go in the evening.

backups.name: Jewish Historical Institute
backups.tips: Home of the Ringelblum Archive; swap in for the synagogue.

backups.name: Bar Bambino Mleczny
backups.tips: A milk bar on Krucza street.

stops.name: Warsaw Uprising Museum
stops.tips: The 1944 uprising; the 3D film 'City of Ruins' and a sewer tunnel. Closed Tuesdays, free on Thursdays, book online.

stops.name: Wola Murals Elektrownia Powiśle
stops.tips: A mall and food venue in a former power plant on the Vistula bank.

stops.name: Elektrownia Powiśle Food Hall
stops.tips: The food hall.

stops.name: Copernicus Science Centre
stops.tips: Interactive science, good with children, with a planetarium and a riverside setting.

stops.name: Vistula Boulevards
stops.tips: The riverside promenade: in summer, bars with sand beaches (Cud nad Wisłą), the Syrenka statue and sunsets.

backups.name: Neon Museum Soho Factory
backups.tips: Communist-era neon signs in Praga; swap in for the science centre.

backups.name: Bar Prasowy Mleczny
backups.tips: A legendary milk bar on Marszałkowska.

stops.name: Łazienki Park
stops.tips: A royal park with peacocks and the Chopin monument (free concerts on summer Sundays at 12:00 and 16:00).

stops.name: Palace on the Isle
stops.tips: A neoclassical summer palace on an island, built for Poniatowski.

stops.name: Belvedere Restaurant Łazienki
stops.tips: A smart lunch in the orangery; a park café is the alternative.

stops.name: Wilanów Palace
stops.tips: Poland's Versailles (King Sobieski), with baroque gardens. Take bus 116 or 180; in winter there is a garden of lights.

stops.name: Wilanów Poster Museum
stops.tips: The Polish poster school, next to the palace.

backups.name: Łazienki Amphitheatre Café
backups.tips: A café in the park for a light bite.

backups.name: Ujazdów Castle CSW
backups.tips: A contemporary art centre next to Łazienki; swap in for Wilanów.

stops.name: Ząbkowska Street Praga
stops.tips: The east bank that survived the war: brick courtyards, shrines to the Virgin Mary, street art. 10 minutes by tram.

stops.name: Koneser Polish Vodka Museum
stops.tips: A museum in a former vodka factory with 3 tastings; the Koneser courtyard.

stops.name: Bazar Różyckiego
stops.tips: An open-air market from 1901; pyzy (potato dumplings) straight from the jar.

stops.name: Bar Mleczny Rusałka Praga
stops.tips: An unchanged retro milk bar next to Praga Park.

stops.name: Soho Factory & Neon Museum
stops.tips: A factory complex with a neon museum and cafés.

backups.name: W Oparach Absurdu
backups.tips: A bar with absurdist décor on Ząbkowska; vodka.

backups.name: Warsaw Zoo
backups.tips: The zoo of The Zookeeper's Wife, in Praga; swap in for Soho.

stops.name: Palace of Culture and Science
stops.tips: Stalin's 237 m gift; the terrace on the 30th floor gives a city panorama.

stops.name: Fryderyk Chopin Museum
stops.tips: Multimedia exhibits in the Ostrogski Palace, including his last piano. Free on Sundays.

stops.name: Kafka Powiśle
stops.tips: A bohemian café next to the Chopin museum, overlooking the river.

stops.name: Holy Cross Church Chopin's Heart
stops.tips: Chopin's heart is kept in a pillar here, on Krakowskie Przedmieście.

stops.name: Chopin Concert Chopin Point
stops.tips: An evening Chopin recital in the old town (daily); in summer, free Sunday concerts at Łazienki.

backups.name: Restauracja Zoni Koneser
backups.tips: Modern Polish cuisine in Praga; swap in for the concert.

backups.name: National Museum Warsaw
backups.tips: Matejko's Grunwald; swap in for the Chopin museum. Free on Tuesdays.

stops.name: Saska Kępa Francuska Street
stops.tips: Modernist villas and cafés in a calm east-bank neighbourhood.

stops.name: Skwer Breakfast Saska Kępa
stops.tips: A neighbourhood café for a farewell breakfast.

stops.name: National Stadium from Outside
stops.tips: The red-and-white national stadium, across the Vistula.

stops.name: Warszawa Centralna Airport Train
stops.tips: The train to Chopin Airport takes 20 minutes. Farewell.

backups.name: Cafe Kulturalna Palace of Culture
backups.tips: A café inside the palace; swap in for Saska Kępa.

backups.name: Museum of Polish History Citadel
backups.tips: A huge new history museum, opened in 2023, at the citadel.
